page.notes: Doubtful readings: the Greek word after "non" (θεομαχῶντες) is uncertain and marked [?]. The Hebrew lines are copied as the printer set them; the word order of the first Hebrew line on the page is hard to confirm. The first word of the first line ("formatus:") is italic. The printed "Va vobis" is kept as printed. The margin notes are placed beside the lines they stand against. The "3." and "4." section numbers are part of the notes. A print error may lie in "Dei lib.VII" and in the hyphenation "augur atricis", which is printed with a space.
